d:
Relive the beautiful feeling of love with “Tere Bin Jiya Na Jaye” from the movie Love Express. Featuring Sahil Mehta and Mannat Ravi, this soulful Hindi song captures the emotions of love, longing, and the special bond between two hearts.
Turn up the music and enjoy this fun-filled Punjabi-style dance number!
Song: Tere Bin Jiya Na Jaye
Singers: Gulshan, Sumitra Iyer
Music : Jaidev Kumar
Lyricist : Rakesh Kumar
Movie Details :
Movie: Love Express
